de578536b073d90339ee7d16b5217e5660676b0a:
query FlxCrmGathering($id: Int!) {
  flxGathering(id: $id) {
    ...FlxCrmGatheringDetail
  }
}

fragment FlxCrmGatheringCard on FlxGathering {
  databaseId
  name
  status
  whenLabel
  place
  phaseTone
  phaseLabel
  peopleCount
  coverUrl
  dateDay
  dateMonth
  dateYear
  stats {
    label
    value
    hint
    progress
  }
  progress
  progressHint
  actions {
    label
    url
    target
    primary
  }
  mailReady
  postId
  pageState
  pageUrl
  pageTitle
  canCreatePage
  startsAt {
    ...FlxCrmWhen
  }
}

fragment FlxCrmGatheringDetail on FlxGathering {
  ...FlxCrmGatheringCard
  summary
  note
  address
  mapUrl
  deliveredCount
  sendCount
  reasons {
    label
    count
    percent
  }
  recentSends {
    ...FlxCrmGatheringSend
  }
}

fragment FlxCrmGatheringSend on FlxGatheringSend {
  eventId
  key
  overall
  overallLabel
  tone
  kind
  text
  at {
    ...FlxCrmWhen
  }
  sendAt {
    ...FlxCrmWhen
  }
  byName
  mediaId
  mediaUrl
  mediaIsImage
  thumbUrl
  channels {
    key
    label
    missing
    sent
    total
    failed
    skipped
    percent
    eta {
      ...FlxCrmWhen
    }
    campaignId
  }
  eta {
    ...FlxCrmWhen
  }
  delivered
  read
  replied
  optout
  failed
  reachedTotal
  canPause
  pending
}

fragment FlxCrmWhen on FlxDateTime {
  iso
  timestamp
  label
  relative
}
